datasets.name: energyvision-public-charging-network-locations-afir-ocpi-2-2-1
datasets.title: EnergyVision Public Charging Network  (AFIR / DATEX II)
datasets.notes:
This dataset provides access to static and dynamic data on publicly accessible electric vehicle charging infrastructure operated by EnergyVision, in accordance with Article 20 of the Alternative Fuels Infrastructure Regulation (AFIR).

The dataset includes:

* Charging station locations (addresses and coordinates)
* EVSE information
* Connector specifications (type, power, format, and related properties)
* Real-time availability and operational status (e.g. available, charging, out of service)
* Operator and sub-operator information
* Ad hoc pricing information, where applicable

Data is provided using the AFIR-compliant DATEX II v3.7 standard. The feeds are provided in XML format and validate against the DATEX II v3.7 AFIR profile.

The dataset consists of:

* A static feed containing charging infrastructure master data
* A dynamic feed containing live operational status, availability, and ad hoc pricing
* Supporting endpoints for schema, metadata, and health monitoring

Access is provided via API. An API key can be requested free of charge by contacting myevplatform@energyvision.be. Access is granted in a non-discriminatory manner in accordance with Article 20 of AFIR.

This dataset is intended for use by mobility service providers, route planners, and other third-party applications and services that consume publicly accessible charging infrastructure data.

datasets.name: evci
datasets.title: EVCI - Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure
datasets.notes:
Context:
In order to facilitate the publication of descriptive data on electric vehicle charging infrastructures (EVCI) and support its customers in their compliance with their regulatory obligations, Gireve, the main electromobility roaming platform in Europe and privileged partner of the players in the ecosystem, offers all operators connected to the platform to subscribe to the service of publication of descriptive data of their charging infrastructures on the National Access Point.

Mode of data production:
The data published comes from data flows transmitted to the Gireve electric vehicle charging roaming platform by operators or their subcontractors via the open OCPI protocol. These data are produced by the operators and transmitted in a fully automated manner.

Additional services:
Gireve also offers a range of quality enhancement and enrichment products and services under a fee-based reuse license.

For more information: www.gireve.com

datasets.name: indigo-open-data-evcharging
datasets.title: indigo-open-data-evcharging
datasets.notes:
Static dataset – Electric Vehicle Charging Stations (DATEX II format)
____
Description
This dataset provides a static description of electric vehicle charging infrastructure in DATEX II format. It enables precise identification of charging stations along with their main technical and operational characteristics.
The information included covers in particular:

Geographical location of stations (coordinates, address)
Site and operator identification
Number of charging points available
Connector types and standards (e.g. Type 2, CCS, CHAdeMO)
Nominal power of charging points

This is a static dataset: it describes the structural characteristics of the infrastructure and does not include real-time information such as availability or operational status.
____
This dataset contributes to the implementation of Article 20 of the Alternative Fuels Infrastructure Regulation (AFIR), which requires Member States to ensure the accessibility, exchange, and reuse of data related to alternative fuel infrastructure, including electric vehicle recharging points. It supports the provision of high-quality data on the location and characteristics of publicly accessible recharging stations.
____
Format
Format: DATEX II (European standard for transport data exchange)
Type: Static publication
Encoding: XML
____
Geographical Coverage
Belgium – national coverage 
____
Update Frequency
On weekday (Monday - Friday)
____

datasets.notes: The AFIR endpoint exposes publicly accessible static and dynamic data from Monta charge points, as required by Article 20 of the AFIR regulation.
